member.notConfigured: An administrator has not configured the platform's Feishu app. You can connect with your own company's Feishu app

ownApp.title: Use my company's Feishu app
ownApp.why: A custom app only connects Feishu accounts in its own organization. If your Feishu belongs to another company, create an app in your company's Feishu first, then enter its credentials here.
ownApp.step1: On the Feishu developer console ({console}), create a custom app.
ownApp.step2: Under Security Settings, add this redirect URL and turn on refreshing user_access_token:
ownApp.step3: Under Permissions, choose batch import/export and paste this configuration, then apply for it:
ownApp.step4: Under Version Management & Release, create and publish a version. Set availability to just yourself, which makes approval much easier. You can give this reason, then wait for your company's Feishu admin to approve:
ownApp.step5: Enter the App ID and App Secret from Credentials & Basic Info above.
ownApp.reason: To search, read and edit my own Feishu documents as myself on Cheese (okcheese.com). Only user-identity permissions are requested, the authorization is started by me, and the app is available to me alone.
ownApp.setupTitle: No app yet? Create one in your company's Feishu with these steps

admin.sub: Fill this in once and members in this app's organization connect with one click in My connections; members whose Feishu belongs to another company connect with their own company's app.
